title: Error Handling
description: Learn how to handle errors gracefully in C# applications.

data.text: **Error handling** is essential for building robust applications that can recover from unexpected situations.
Without proper error handling, applications crash when they encounter unexpected inputs or conditions. Good error handling makes your app resilient and user-friendly.

data.title: Common Errors
data.content: Examples of things that can go wrong

data.title: Exceptions vs Return Codes
data.text: C# uses exceptions for error handling. Exceptions are objects that carry error information up the call stack until they're caught.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Errors are inevitable in real applications
C# uses exceptions for error handling
Handle errors gracefully for better UX
data.takeaway: Error handling makes apps robust and reliable.
